name: pinterest-register-visual
description: PRODUCT multimodal Pinterest register (0.2.3): CloakBrowser screenshot → OpenAI-compatible vision JSON actions → execute; same-session nurture BEFORE ctx.close. Bot must call scripts/run_pinterest_register_visual_mm.py. computerUse is not the product path. Never system Chrome. IMAP via scripts/outlook_imap_pinterest_code.py. Nurture 0.1.7+.

steps.text: PRODUCT PATH: python_runner scripts/run_pinterest_register_visual_mm.py (also repo scripts/). Bot must exec this runner. Free computerUse / visual_operator clicking is NOT the product path.

PREFLIGHT: Require DISPLAY for headed CloakBrowser. Load profiles/<PROFILE>/profile.json for proxy + identity. Secrets only from SECRETS_ENV. LLM from config/llm.json + CLOAKCLI_LLM_API_KEY (default model grok-4.6; vision: CLOAKCLI_LLM_VISION_MODEL then llm.json vision_model then text model). Never --api-key. NEVER launch system Chrome.

LAUNCH: Runner opens headed CloakBrowser persistent context with profile proxy. Do not wipe user_data_dir unless --fresh-profile at attempt start (refuse if .cloak_session_ok). Do not change fingerprint knobs.

MM LOOP: screenshot (viewport JPEG, never full-page) → vision chat/completions image_url → JSON action click|type|press|wait|scroll|imap_fetch_code|nurture|done|fail → CloakBrowser execute. Human pacing 800–2500ms fields; 2–5s before Continue; 3–8s settle after. Artifacts: artifacts/pinterest/visual/<profile>/

FILL: Prefer {"field":"email|password|birthday|name|code"} — runner auto-binds #email #password #birthdate #code (birthday YYYY-MM-DD). Do not retype filled fields. After all three signup fields, click button:has-text('Continue') (not Google). Vision timeouts retry 2–3×.

CODE / SETTINGS: imap_fetch_code uses scripts/outlook_imap_pinterest_code.py then type {{CODE}}. Settings Confirm Email path if no code challenge. Oops → oops_blocked park. IMAP/UI miss → verify_soft_fail.

NURTURE CHAIN (mandatory default): ANY success status (registered_ok, browsed_ok, …) only after independent login heuristic (account menu / pin feed / no unauth Log in+Sign up CTA). Model done/nurture are hints — done:browsed_ok on a register/login page is rejected. Then DO NOT ctx.close yet. Touch .cloak_session_ok; flush; session_keepalive_probe; run_nurture_session 0.1.7+. Login wall → nurture_status=session_lost_before_nurture. Nurture fail does not negate register. Skip only with --skip-nurture (warning).

REPORT: Final JSON version 0.2.3, status from this package manifest.json (success flags + exit codes); unknown model status → visual_stuck. Plus path, nurture_status, nurture_elapsed_s, elapsed_s, profile. Model reason/path run through redact_text. Smoke: --dry-run mock vision.
